lines.text: Turbulence ahead. I suggest you pack like you mean it.
Gravity storm on the route. Your cargo will dance. Badly.
Asteroid field. I will dodge. Your boxes will not.
The jump is rough today. As every day. Pack tight.
Navigation says: hold on. Cargo says nothing. Cargo never listens.
My namesake called an ocean 'peaceful'. This jump is not that ocean.
